title: A Unified Kalman-Type Classification of Controllability for Linear Stochastic Systems
abstract: Formalization of a finite algebraic classification of approximate, approximate null, exact null, and exact controllability for finite-dimensional linear stochastic systems with constant coefficients and independent Brownian drivers. A decreasing subspace sequence gives a common obstruction for the first three properties; exact controllability additionally requires full row rank of the stacked diffusion-control matrix. The development also covers stochastic integration, forward and backward equations, duality, finite rank tests, null feedback, and polynomial small-time energy bounds. The independent Palomar statement and its solution compile with Lean v4.35.0-rc2 and canonical Mathlib. Complete sandboxed mechanical preflight and editorial review are separate requirements; no registration is claimed.
